property_summary: For any locked-in guess g at target block T, settle() from the guesser completes (ok==true) exactly when g differs from blockhash(T) (a loser walks away; a winner's 2-ether payout cannot fit the 1-ether balance and reverts); the mutant pays losers, so its payout attempt reverts and settle() fails for every losing guess, violating ok == (g != blockhash(T)).
change_summary: Change the winning comparison from equality to inequality so losers are paid and winners are not.
